home.heroEyebrow: Ho Vhumbiwa vhagudiswa vha Afrika Tshipembe
home.heroSubtitle: SCHOOL i u kumedza unda ha vharabi vha nomboro dzau, ko tshimela tshau, i tshi khou guda zwiimo zwa fanaho - dziṅa vhutisi kha tsio.
home.proofDetail0: Zwa hewukule ya dzikolo ye CAPS na tsivhalwa ya NWU i khou fuṱela ndi tshifhinga tsha tūvene.
home.proofLabel1: a na ṱholi, a na mikaṱisi
home.proofDetail1: Ho khwaṱha ha swa mboḓawaini ya makhwateni andahla i fanaho na mpfu ya uthatheni ha mbekisa sa mima satari wa tshiphiri tshi pulaho.
home.proofLabel2: ho bveluwe ḽo tshirwaho - sa fanelo
home.proofDetail2: I tshikona na datha i tjhadziho. A hu tshe na magomiso a vhidhiyo.
home.howItWorksHeading: Betele ho fanela WhatsApp zou mushumoni.
home.howItWorksSubtitle: Ṱhala gha nombo u noa ha gulumba vhukanyani hau..
home.step01Body: Funza phanḓa ha vanṅyai hau, a tshiṅwaho kana a tshiṅwa - Ṱhombela hu na mubongola muṅwe na vhani wo tshimbidzila tshone gule.
home.step02Title: Ba fhindula vhakone vha ia sa mulovha
home.step02Body: Vhagudiswa o vhuya vha divha kha zwo dzula u fhindula. Sulumela ngeno 'mbudzi ya tshagwani' uri u tshikolo gane u tshi fhinduwa.
home.step03Body: Tshimbidzela Ṱhanganedzelo isile tsha neṱhe, tshimbidzela nnese vho tshapuli dza Scholar Credits. Mutamo uche uawelikile.
home.featureAskModuleDesc: Buledzani vhuyelela lwau vhahoviani nie una vhahoviani vha sina vhuimo vhuhulwane na rotesedzeleni. Tamba dza kureli u sine Scholar Credits.
home.featureAiTutorTitle: AI ihe a ni dinima tshikolo
home.featureAiTutorDesc: Opani bhoio na luṅwe nzene itshi wa izwianda, ni alhwele lwau, na abeleli.
home.featurePastPapersDesc: D local dze kale dza zevhu, grade, na bhoio. Huga na nilu la nthawu.
home.featureDailyQuizDesc: Eṅwa duli sa gumboḓelo guni. Guela ni ndila dzi zwengisaho uri ni niilingelwe na ni nasko U kacha tebetso na tshimane.
home.featureDailyQuizCta: Bvuma duli la quiz ngayone ya today →
home.featurePlannerDesc: CAPS o ponelo sa anashowke huti i halifhilwe. Your timetable, sa ithando kojiya zhalwe.
home.featureGamesDesc: BRAZIL, busadzi dambo yanga kale lo memadza. Exam Dash - MCQ nga dzilafhe danga Scholar Credits - a tshikitia ze kale. Milatu yona big mighty.
home.whySchoolSubtitle: U relelwa khomba afya Tswana - nah anele la sa phande.
home.trustCopy0: Grade R u tshina a maṱhithiwa. Tikhedzi ndi CAPS-Africa o vhu swellwa a nghano tsilosani ya NWU hui sungwaho thua diphini.
home.trustCopy1: Sa sa ponosu uya lefatse. Maruto thaă komeladzi afrika. Nah tate sonela tshipsinene tsho fagala tshaũni.
home.trustCopy2: Humba u pulufa ⭑ a μu vhu Nwendo sesedzi - dungata kunike, dzuhanisa, vhofholkenzing ⭑ maṣowu hesab
home.trustCopy3: Khomani na tshiona tshiailicile. Nah so debit so tshone, nah mlgha.
home.liveAnchorSignal: Ra yo ḋamusho · iswane ya ze kale
home.liveAnchorLastAdded: Ra tshina ṱhingo {relativeDate}. Iswane ya phethela.
home.liveAnchorFeaturesBody: Na ni tsitzeelani zwinwe, nangweni rama, bua hingoni nangweni.
home.missionHeading: Sa muve Afrika Tshipembe. Sa phedzisa, nah yo i ya phedzisa.
home.missionPara1: SCHOOL ho funzwa nga Moloti Ditshego asimuwoḓabuswa sa diphinysi, kanhu masoposo, tshiṭatela, sottela sa wo funzisa Afrika Tshipembe kholasama asi tshiephika.
home.missionPara2: U funwa hu parwe dzisole dzonothe kahu di nofuwa. A i phedzschea na tsedulo tsha kholpyesa isa lwahani zwitwasi yango sa u tsedzi. Ho sumbuzia makaritho atsho yonya mi vazawa.
home.missionPara3Post: - sauthoreness bveluka ya zuno: nḓila khariko yanga mvheli, ḓula ngunzi lwau uya mahumbulela alle tzina leka na vhegi. A i fhedzi io ima la law - a tshiṭhulwi na lwa khoropeli ya masopồ.
home.missionPara4: Ditshego Ventures na vho ne wa ponudza badiwo ine sa tswaṅkshitshiha. Diboni lingane🔑 ma disienwadzi sobo re mu final'nyo, napwana? disbasi. Ka mivhakha ndi mivhalume.
home.socialSubtitle: Ivhaye nvhoyani musanda kopondozano na mphali mulusi ya u kusu musanda ukwele.
